note: Havana Park District campground in Riverfront Park beside the Havana Nature Center. The sites sit across the park road and an open lawn from the Illinois River, about 100 m from the water; the dump station is nearby rather than in the campground. Playgrounds, shelters, boat ramps and fishing docks in the park; the district pool is across the street and downtown a few blocks away. RV Life mislabels it commercial. --Claude
